title.hr: Kantica sa žetonima i kantica koja curi

concept.hr: Nalet propušten odjednom ili razvučen u čekanje
concept.en: A burst let through at once, or spread out as delay

summary.hr: Pošalji nalete kroz dva ograničivača iste brzine: kantica sa žetonima propušta do b odjednom, a red jedan po jedan, uz čekanje.
summary.en: Send bursts through two limiters of the same rate: the token bucket passes up to b at once, the leaky bucket one by one, with delay.
